checkpoint-branch.notes: Legacy P0. All work is uncommitted incl. this session's fixes — commit ALL of it, tag pre-nx-baseline, branch feat/nx-migration. No code changes beyond committing what exists. Resumability of every later state depends on the tag. The guard captures $? directly and re-runs pnpm test to prove nothing regressed by the commit.

nx-init.notes: Legacy P1. nx init + configure: target defaults (@nx/js:tsc), named inputs, module-boundary lint (type:extension/type:lib/type:app), cache, nx release + commitlint. Nx is dev-time only (inv:nx-dev-only) — add to root devDependencies ONLY. Do NOT move existing extensions/scripts here (that is engine/convergence). Existing test suite must stay green.

manifest-lib.notes: Legacy P2. libs/manifest = single source of truth for validate() + schema, with the 3 contract flexes [shape:manifest-flexes]. Port the existing scripts/validate-manifests behavior; do NOT delete scripts/validate-manifests.ts yet (thin-wrapped in migrate-rest). libs/manifest has NO @nx/devkit dep (pure lib). Ordering: this MUST precede authoring-lib.

authoring-lib.notes: Legacy P3. libs/authoring = pure scaffold(opts)->FileSet (inv:nx-free-core); @adhd/sox-nx = thin adapters; born-conformance gate (scaffold->build->validate per type); scaffold-parity test (inv:scaffold-parity). D4: DELETE the 6 demo extensions (they become generated fixtures) — they appear in artifacts because this state removes them. prompt is parked (no generator). Carry scripts/new-extension.ts logic forward, fix its gaps (missing tsconfig, keywords/author).

audit-foundation.notes: Mandatory hold point. Verifies every checkpoint-branch/nx-init/manifest-lib/authoring-lib criterion against the real repo before the engine phase. No deferrable items. The audit script is read-only; fixes happen in source.

engine-libs.notes: Legacy P4. CODE-MOVING STATE — run gitnexus impact/context on every symbol BEFORE moving, gitnexus detect-changes AFTER. Re-home scripts/{install,cascade,build-index,host/*,provider-capabilities} into 3 nx libs carrying [def:session-fixes] forward (inv:fix-carry-forward) — NEVER re-grab pre-fix code. Fix the flag parser (A12, [ref:dual-flag-form]) + exec routing while re-homing the CLI. apps/soxe is a stub shell here; behavior wired in sox-extension. Do NOT delete scripts/ originals.

sox-extension.notes: Legacy P5. Wire apps/sox = literal extension #0 (D1/D2, [ref:self-hosted-extension-zero]). Its own extension.json (type:command) MUST validate against libs/manifest. All verbs delegate to engine libs; init uses libs/authoring scaffold() (A1); exec via running server (A11). A12 both flag forms flow through the live CLI.

audit-engine.notes: Mandatory hold point. Re-runs the foundation phase then verifies engine-libs + sox-extension criteria (A12 parser, fixes carried forward, self-hosting validation) against the real repo. No deferrable items.

type-discovery.notes: Legacy P6. Bounded discovery: read SHAPE per type from the real corpus (NOT ingestion). Refine libs/authoring templates + confirm/adjust libs/manifest flexes (additive/backward-compatible only). born-conformance + scaffold-parity must stay green. Note: this state and authoring-lib both touch libs/authoring/src/templates and libs/manifest/src/schema.json, but they run strictly sequentially (authoring-lib → audit-foundation → ... → type-discovery), never in parallel, so no merge protocol is needed.

memory-core.notes: Legacy P7. CODE-MOVING STATE — gitnexus impact/context BEFORE extracting each shared module, gitnexus detect-changes AFTER (confirm only the 4 memory extensions are affected). Extract shared db/schema/embed/recall/write into libs/memory-core (C7). Re-point every cross-extension ../**/dist/ reach-in to libs/memory-core ([ref:no-cross-extension-reachin]); module-boundary lint must be clean. C5 (memory_write+memory_recall) must still work. libs/memory-core is internal (not published).

migrate-rest.notes: Legacy P8. CODE-MOVING STATE — gitnexus impact/context before relocating each extension, detect-changes after. Add project.json + type:extension tags so every remaining extension is in the nx graph; validate every manifest against libs/manifest. Thin-wrap scripts/validate-manifests.ts to import libs/manifest validate() ([ref:manifest-single-source]) — ALL 44 tests must stay green. nx run-many -t build,lint clean across ALL projects. (project.json files are created broadly; the single shared-with-other-states mutation is scripts/validate-manifests.ts, hence it is the declared artifact — see context Reservations for the full per-extension project.json scope.)

ci-release.notes: Legacy P9. CI runs nx affected -t build,lint,test,validate; nx release replaces Changesets (D3); commitlint pre-commit hook; reality-gate tests (process-table) re-homed as nx targets (NOT deleted); per-type docs/guidelines/<type>.md for all 6 active types. DELETE scripts/scaffolder.test.ts (replaced by born-conformance gate) — it is in artifacts because this state removes it. No previously-green test removed.

audit-final.notes: Legacy P10 = the final audit. Operationalizes every [dod.N] and every [ref:] into positive/negative/live-data checks against REALITY ([def:reality-check]) from a clean slate. No deferrable items. On green, the founder accepts and this state's executor sets state: complete (terminal done).

done.notes: Terminal sentinel. Reached only after audit-final exits 0 and the founder accepts. No work; the guard re-asserts the final audit so the terminal state is itself verifiable. state: complete is set here.
